title: Does cardio kill your gains? 🏃
caption:
A 2022 meta-analysis found cardio did not reduce muscle growth or max strength from lifting. Explosive power took a small hit, mostly with running in the same session. Lift first, keep cardio moderate, eat enough. Cardio or no cardio? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 14
first_comment: Team cardio or team "my car is my cardio"? 🚗
sources: Schumann M et al. Compatibility of concurrent aerobic and strength training for skeletal muscle size and function: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis. Sports Med 2022;52:601-612
Wilson JM et al. Concurrent training: a meta-analysis examining interference of aerobic and resistance exercises. J Strength Cond Res 2012;26:2293-2307
